watch.summary: The streamer bursts into laughter after hearing an official VCT trailer promote an upcoming tournament location by highlighting its 'great transit'.

beats.what: Streamer watches an official Valorant esports trailer.
The trailer narrator lists selling points: 'great food, great transit, and even better competition'.
The streamer bursts out laughing at 'great transit'.
Streamer cracks up repeating 'Great food, great transit! I'm sold!'
Streamer continues giggling and gives a thumbs up as the video continues.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Great food, great transit, I'm sold!
watch.why: The streamer highlights the absurdity of an esports tournament trailer using public transportation as a key hype point. His genuine, infectious laughter carries the quick reaction.
